description: Baseline: map current urgency probability monotonically across six horizons

asi.hypothesis: The production urgency score may provide a weak ordered-horizon baseline when mapped monotonically into six classes.
asi.learning: Urgency separates evergreen articles well (AUC 0.87) but collapses argmax predictions and gives very poor macro F1, leaving substantial room for an article-content model.

description: Multinomial logistic regression over normalized EmbeddingGemma vectors

asi.hypothesis: EmbeddingGemma vectors encode semantic lifetime cues that a regularized multinomial linear classifier can recover.
asi.learning: Embedding-only logistic regression halves RPS versus urgency mapping and improves all probability-sensitive metrics; direct semantic representation is a strong baseline despite modest hard-label kappa.

description: Increase multinomial embedding regularization with C=0.3

asi.hypothesis: Stronger regularization may smooth overconfident class probabilities and lower RPS on the temporal test split.
asi.learning: C=0.3 underfits the embedding signal: RPS, macro F1, kappa, and MAE all worsen versus C=1.0.
asi.next_action_hint: Try moderately weaker regularization or a structurally different ordinal/text model.

description: Reduce embedding logistic regularization with C=3

asi.hypothesis: The small training set still benefits from a less constrained embedding decision surface because pretrained vectors already carry strong semantic structure.
asi.learning: C=3 improves RPS by 0.0081 over C=1 and also improves every secondary metric, indicating the C=1 model was underfitting rather than overconfident.

description: Further reduce embedding logistic regularization with C=10

asi.hypothesis: A still weaker L2 penalty may recover finer semantic horizon distinctions without unacceptable probability overconfidence.
asi.learning: C=10 improves RPS, kappa, and duration MAE; evergreen AUC and macro F1 dip slightly, but the ordered probability quality improves clearly.

description: Test weak embedding logistic regularization with C=30

asi.hypothesis: C=30 may continue the C=1 to C=10 improvement trend by sharpening semantic class boundaries.
asi.learning: The RPS optimum is below C=30: confidence rises to 0.71 and duration MAE improves, but probability calibration and most classification metrics regress.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep C=10 and test ordinal decomposition or text features instead of pushing regularization further.

description: Ordinal cumulative logistic classifiers over normalized embeddings

asi.hypothesis: Five cumulative boundary classifiers align training directly with the ordered structure measured by RPS.
asi.learning: Ordinal decomposition yields a small RPS gain and clear improvements in macro F1, kappa, and evergreen AUC over multinomial C=10; monotone tail probabilities prevent invalid negative class mass.

description: Increase ordinal boundary regularization with C=3

asi.hypothesis: More regularized cumulative classifiers may improve boundary calibration.
asi.learning: As with multinomial classification, C=3 underfits; RPS and ordered hard-label metrics regress materially.
asi.next_action_hint: Try weaker ordinal regularization around C=20 or add independent lexical temporal cues.

description: Reduce ordinal boundary regularization with C=20

asi.hypothesis: Ordinal boundary models may benefit from slightly sharper fits than C=10.
asi.learning: C=20 lowers RPS and duration MAE despite small declines in hard-label metrics and evergreen AUC; probability sharpness helps overall ordered calibration.

description: Test sharper ordinal boundary fits with C=40

asi.hypothesis: C=40 may improve class separation while preserving ordinal probability quality.
asi.learning: C=40 improves kappa and duration MAE but is slightly over-sharp for RPS and lowers evergreen AUC; C=20 is the calibration optimum in this range.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep ordinal C=20; test text-only signals or an embedding/text ensemble.

description: Blend ordinal probabilities with 5% training class prior

asi.hypothesis: A small class-prior blend may reduce overconfidence and improve temporal-test calibration.
asi.learning: Prior smoothing worsens both RPS and duration MAE without changing hard decisions; the C=20 ordinal probabilities are not globally overconfident.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not apply global smoothing; add complementary lexical features.

description: Word TF-IDF multinomial classifier over titles and article bodies

asi.hypothesis: Explicit lexical date, deadline, and event words may predict horizon better than dense semantic embeddings.
asi.learning: Text-only word TF-IDF is much better than urgency but clearly worse than embeddings on RPS and every secondary metric; lexical cues may still be complementary in an ensemble.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS was 0.10525204 versus 0.09039041 for ordinal embeddings.
asi.next_action_hint: Combine sparse TF-IDF with embeddings or blend text probabilities at low weight rather than replacing embeddings.

description: Blend 20% word TF-IDF predictions into ordinal embeddings

asi.hypothesis: Lexical predictions may correct embedding errors when blended conservatively.
asi.learning: A 20% text blend slightly improves hard-label metrics but worsens RPS, duration MAE, and evergreen AUC; text errors are not complementary enough at this weight.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS regressed from 0.09039041 to 0.09203494 and added substantial complexity.
asi.next_action_hint: If revisited, try direct feature concatenation or at most a very small text weight; prioritize simpler explicit temporal features.

description: Concatenate word TF-IDF with embeddings for ordinal classification

asi.hypothesis: Joint linear boundary models can use lexical cues only when they add information beyond embeddings.
asi.learning: Adding 5k TF-IDF features increases confidence and slightly improves duration MAE, but RPS and evergreen discrimination regress; sparse lexical detail overfits the small training set.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS regressed from 0.09039041 to 0.09254488 with much higher feature dimensionality.
asi.next_action_hint: Use a tiny fixed temporal feature set instead of thousands of lexical dimensions.

description: Append fixed temporal phrase flags to ordinal embeddings

asi.hypothesis: A small hand-chosen multilingual temporal vocabulary may add deadline and recency cues missing from dense embeddings.
asi.learning: Temporal flags raise weighted kappa strongly but worsen RPS and evergreen AUC; binary phrase presence sharpens some hard decisions while harming probability ranking.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS regressed from 0.09039041 to 0.09139687 and the added vocabulary increases maintenance complexity.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid hand-maintained cue lists unless a much smaller or cross-validated formulation improves RPS.

description: Balance classes independently at each ordinal boundary

asi.hypothesis: Boundary class imbalance may suppress rare short horizons, so balanced losses could improve ordered predictions.
asi.learning: Full balancing greatly improves macro F1 and kappa but badly degrades RPS and duration calibration; optimized class frequencies encode useful priors that should not be erased.
asi.next_action_hint: If class reweighting is revisited, use a mild fractional correction rather than fully balanced weights.

description: Apply quarter-power class balancing to ordinal boundaries

asi.hypothesis: A mild quarter-power correction can recover minority-boundary signal without discarding empirical class priors.
asi.learning: Fractional balancing lowers RPS by 0.00138 and substantially improves kappa, unlike full balancing; gentle prior correction is useful while alpha=1 is too aggressive.

description: Reduce ordinal class-balance correction exponent to one eighth

asi.hypothesis: A smaller imbalance correction may retain more calibration while still helping rare boundaries.
asi.learning: Alpha 0.125 gives slightly better macro F1 and MAE but worse RPS than alpha 0.25; the stronger quarter-power correction better matches ordered probability errors.
asi.next_action_hint: Test alpha 0.375 to locate whether the optimum lies above 0.25.

description: Increase ordinal class-balance correction exponent to three eighths

asi.hypothesis: A slightly stronger fractional balance than one quarter may improve rare-boundary ranking without the calibration damage of full balancing.
asi.learning: Alpha 0.375 gives a small RPS gain and large macro F1/kappa gains; the calibration optimum is between mild and full balancing.

description: Use square-root class balancing at ordinal boundaries

asi.hypothesis: Square-root balancing may be the midpoint between empirical and fully balanced boundary priors.
asi.learning: Alpha 0.5 passes the optimum: RPS, macro F1, kappa, and MAE all regress versus alpha 0.375 despite a negligible AUC gain.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep alpha 0.375; tune model regularization jointly or test another representation.

description: Increase regularization for fractionally balanced ordinal models with C=10

asi.hypothesis: Fractional class weighting may require stronger regularization than the unweighted optimum.
asi.learning: C=10 underfits ordered probabilities and duration, though it slightly improves evergreen AUC; alpha 0.375 still prefers C=20.
asi.next_action_hint: Test C=30 or 40 with alpha 0.375 to bracket the joint optimum.

description: Reduce regularization for fractionally balanced ordinal models with C=30

asi.hypothesis: A sharper C=30 fit may improve the fractionally balanced boundary probabilities.
asi.learning: C=30 is effectively tied but marginally worse on RPS and clearly worse on macro F1/kappa; C=20 remains simpler and better calibrated.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS increased by 0.00001663 and no secondary tradeoff justified keeping it.
asi.next_action_hint: Stop tuning C around 20; test PCA, centroids, or urgency blending.

description: Append production urgency probability to embedding features

asi.hypothesis: The separately trained urgency probability may add a compact orthogonal signal to semantic embeddings.
asi.learning: Urgency adds no useful information beyond the same underlying embeddings and degrades RPS, duration MAE, and evergreen AUC.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not reuse production urgency in the intrinsic model; focus on representation geometry.

description: Whiten embeddings through 64-component PCA before ordinal classification

asi.hypothesis: PCA whitening may remove noisy embedding directions and improve temporal generalization.
asi.learning: Compressing to 64 whitened components loses useful lifetime structure and worsens every probability-sensitive metric; L2 regularization in the full embedding space is preferable.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid aggressive dimensionality reduction; try a distance-based or ridge-regression ordinal model.

description: Ridge regression on cumulative horizon targets with alpha=1

asi.hypothesis: Multi-output ridge regression directly minimizes the squared cumulative errors used by RPS.
asi.learning: Direct squared-loss cumulative regression improves evergreen AUC but underfits class ordering and trails logistic boundaries on RPS; alpha=1 may be too strong.
asi.next_action_hint: Try weaker ridge alpha once because the direct objective is promising, then abandon if still behind.

description: Reduce cumulative ridge regularization to alpha=0.1

asi.hypothesis: A weaker ridge penalty may recover the semantic boundary detail lost at alpha=1.
asi.learning: Alpha 0.1 improves hard ordering versus alpha=1 but barely improves RPS and sharply harms evergreen AUC; squared-loss regression is inferior to logistic boundaries here.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS remains far above the 0.08881373 logistic result.
asi.next_action_hint: Abandon ridge; spend remaining runs on nearest-centroid evidence or conservative refinements to the best model.

description: Shrinkage linear discriminant analysis over normalized embeddings

asi.hypothesis: Covariance-aware linear discriminant analysis may exploit embedding geometry beyond independent logistic boundaries.
asi.learning: Shrinkage LDA is extremely overconfident (0.95) and has poor RPS despite excellent expected-duration MAE; its probabilities are unsuitable without heavy calibration.
asi.next_action_hint: Do not pursue covariance models on 266 rows; retain regularized logistic boundaries.

description: Five-fold sigmoid calibration for each ordinal boundary

asi.hypothesis: Training-only cross-validated sigmoid calibration may improve cumulative boundary probabilities.
asi.learning: Calibration improves evergreen AUC but worsens RPS, kappa, and MAE; fold-level fitting loses more semantic signal than the sigmoid correction recovers.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary RPS regressed from 0.08881373 to 0.08984338 and model complexity increased substantially.
asi.next_action_hint: Keep the direct probability outputs; use remaining runs for a tiny coefficient refinement or validation repeat.

description: Refine fractional class-balance exponent from 0.375 to 0.35

asi.hypothesis: Quadratic interpolation of tested exponents suggests the local RPS optimum is near 0.35.
asi.learning: The measured gain is only 0.0000096 with unchanged hard metrics, far below a meaningful effect and likely benchmark-specific; retaining the interpretable three-eighths setting better avoids test-set overfitting.
asi.rollback_reason: Discarded despite nominal primary improvement because it is negligible, test-tuned, and below the prompt's 0.001 equivalence threshold.
asi.next_action_hint: Use the final run to confirm the retained best deterministically rather than tuning another decimal.

description: Determinism check of retained ordinal embedding model

asi.hypothesis: The retained model and fixed harness should reproduce bit-for-bit before ending the initial segment.
asi.learning: All six metrics exactly match experiment 19, confirming deterministic training, prediction, and evaluation.
asi.rollback_reason: No code change and no primary improvement; logged as a validation run only.
asi.next_action_hint: Review the retained model on a new frozen temporal holdout or human-audited labels before further hyperparameter tuning.
